meta.name: Three-machine line
meta.description: Parts are cut, welded, moved on a 2 min transfer, then painted. Written fresh at M1 to the spec 2 targets: weld utilization 0.85 to 0.92, the other stations below 0.70. Parts arrive 30 per hour (exponential, mean 2 min). Utilization = arrival rate x mean service time / capacity: cut 30 per hour x 1.2 min = 0.60; weld 30 per hour x 1.8 min = 0.90; paint 30 per hour x 1 min = 0.50. By Burke's theorem each station sees Poisson arrivals, so each is M/M/1 with mean wait rho / (1 - rho) x service time: cut 1.8 min, weld 16.2 min, paint 1.0 min. Mean cycle time (time in each station, wait plus service, and the transfer) cut 3.0 + weld 18.0 + transfer 2 + paint 2.0 = 25.0 min; throughput 30 per hour. The weld station is the bottleneck.
